title: Dream of weird food /concession stand/ school dream
content: One of the few school dreams I had now there was a mini food place down stairs , had to go down many stairs to access , couldn’t really go inside and had to reach them through a walk through window . The food place was blue and white the window where I had to order was stainless steel. As far as the school dream it was connected because a football game was going on . It felt like I was being pushed out of the game and chased by guards but the only safe place was the food stand . The colors the players were wearing were maroon … same Chinese lady many time at the food place recognized me. I would be at the food place seeking refuge then being chased again then at the food place .. also seemed like I was at a office building then a different hotel then I have been to in mall world.. a ton of chaos…
